changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[ROUTINES] where SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'utility' and SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GetBreadcrumbStringWrapper') begin IF EXISTS (SELECT f.name FROM sys.Computed_columns f inner join sys.objects o on f.object_id = o.object_id where SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) = 'dbo' and o.name = 'FusionAttributeType' and F.name ='TextPath' and f.is_computed = 1 ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] DROP column [TextPath]
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] ADD [TextPath] nvarchar(1000) END
IF EXISTS (SELECT f.name FROM sys.Computed_columns f inner join sys.objects o on f.object_id = o.object_id where SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) = 'dbo' and o.name = 'FusionAttributeType_backup' and F.name ='TextPath' and f.is_computed = 1 ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_backup] DROP column [TextPath]
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_backup] ADD [TextPath] nvarchar(1000) END drop FUNCTION [utility].[GetBreadcrumbStringWrapper] END
